value.rationale: The 2026 sharp complete inequality motivates asking which analytic matrix-valued symbols actually attain the constant. The theorem classifies all exact maximizers at any rectangular matrix level and shows quantitative H2 closeness of every coefficient of the whole symbol, not only its finite-dimensional evaluation, at a dimension-free and exponent-sharp rate. This is a natural structural extremal classification, with a strict limitation to the rank-one square-zero Jordan matrix.
